subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default config key, or keep TUI delivery controlled only by launch flags and shell aliases?
rationale: The current request is useful ergonomics, but it adds a new `openclaw.json` default surface and changes the TUI's documented internal-source/off-by-default delivery model, so automation should not choose the product direction.

options.title: Keep launch-only delivery
options.body: Leave delivery opt-in through `--deliver` and aliases, keeping `tui` config limited to presentation unless maintainers explicitly expand that surface.

options.title: Approve a narrow config key
options.body: Add one canonical launch-time delivery default key with schema/help/docs/tests and keep CLI flags as the explicit override.

options.title: Revisit the product default
options.body: Consider flipping TUI delivery default or adding `--no-deliver`, but treat that as broader product behavior beyond this config request.

recommendation.title: Keep launch-only delivery
recommendation.body: Leave delivery opt-in through `--deliver` and aliases, keeping `tui` config limited to presentation unless maintainers explicitly expand that surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent routing candidate for the current TUI/config files and repo-wide config policy surfaced in this review.
